Non-negotiable

Safety is the luxury standard

On the premier Gulf Coast spearfishing charter, professionalism is not marketing—it is the gate that keeps every guest dive intentional.

Certification by trip

  • Inshore & Reef — Basic freediving or Open Water SCUBA minimum.
  • Offshore Oil Rig & Bluewater — FII/PFI Level 1 freediver or Advanced Open Water SCUBA.
  • Lionfish Conservation — Open Water SCUBA certified.

Agency details and cert numbers are collected during booking. Captains verify before departure. Unverified credentials stay on the dock.

Captain authority

USCG Masters retain final say on weather, site selection, dive plans, and cancellation. Green, Yellow, and Red calls are published to your guest itinerary. Challenging a Red call does not put you in the water—it ends the discussion.

Onboard standards

  • Oxygen and first-aid kits on every vessel.
  • EPIRB and offshore life raft on Rig Hunter for bluewater range.
  • Electronic liability waiver required before deposit confirmation.
  • No alcohol on charter days.
  • Maximum six divers—USCG 6-pack compliance.

Safety is how we stay the definitive Orange Beach spearfishing operation—not a volume outfit racing other boats to the same pin.
